summary: Multi-dimensional quantity delivered at the job (loaded at depot, dropped here); consumes vehicle capacity.
range: Array of non-negative integers; dimension count must match vehicles.capacity.
businessRules: Delivered load must fit remaining capacity at every step (C1).

delivery defines: In case the job involves a delivery step, use this attribute to describe delivery quantity. This attribute supports multidimensional quantities, to support delivering quantities of different units/…
Each element in delivery must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.capacity, jobs.pickup. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Capacity dimensions must match across jobs, shipments, and vehicles.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Boundary: delivery equal to capacity fits; +1 breaches -> unassigned.
Infeasible: delivery exceeds every vehicle's capacity -> unassigned (capacity reason).
Interaction: Negative: capacity [10,100] but a job delivery [5] (1 dim vs 2) -> HTTP 400 input validation failed.
Interaction: Positive: capacity [10,100] with all deliveries/pickups/amounts 2-dimensional -> accepted.
Interaction: Consistency: alternative_capacities with different dimension than primary capacity -> HTTP 400.
Interaction: Consistency: min_stop_load [20,30] but capacity [10,100] only -> dimension mismatch HTTP 400.
